purpose: prospective familywise certification for balanced paired validation groups using one shared block resample and replicate-specific cluster studentization

estimator.cell_gain: ratio of weighted gain numerator sums to weight masses over shared validation blocks
estimator.point_standard_error: cluster ratio influence standard error computed separately for every group x contrast cell
estimator.bootstrap_draw: sample the common block IDs once and reuse the identical sampled sequence across every group and contrast
estimator.replicate_standard_error: recompute the cluster ratio influence standard error inside each bootstrap replicate for every estimable cell
estimator.max_t_statistic: maximum across all estimable group x contrast cells of abs(theta_star - theta_hat) / se_star
estimator.interval: theta_hat plus/minus bootstrap-t critical value times original-sample cluster ratio standard error

zero_variance_rule.zero_se_nonzero_displacement: t contribution is infinity and the simultaneous interval fails conservatively
